name: ssh
description: Manage and analyze remote Linux systems via SSH within AI assistants.

settings.name: SSH Host
settings.description: IP address or hostname of the remote SSH server

settings.name: SSH Password
settings.description: SSH login password (leave empty if using key authentication)

settings.name: SSH Key File
settings.description: Path to SSH private key file (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_rsa)

settings.name: SSH Ignore Known Hosts
settings.description: Skip host key verification, set true for internal or dev servers
